seoTitle: How to Fix ChatGPT 'Conversation Not Found' Error
metaDescription: Resolve the ChatGPT 'Conversation Not Found' error caused by expired sessions, deleted chats, or cache issues with these fixes.
intro: Trying to reopen an older ChatGPT conversation only to see a 'Conversation Not Found' message is a common and fixable problem. This guide covers the usual causes, from expired sessions to cache issues, and the steps to get your chat history back.

steps.heading: Refresh your ChatGPT session
steps.body: Reload the page or restart the app to refresh your session, which can resolve temporary loading glitches.

steps.heading: Log out and log back in
steps.body: Sign out of ChatGPT and log back in to reset any expired session tokens that may be causing the error.

steps.heading: Clear browser cache
steps.body: Clear your browser's cached data for the ChatGPT site, since stale cache can sometimes interfere with loading older chats.

steps.heading: Check if the chat was deleted
steps.body: Confirm the conversation wasn't previously deleted, since deleted chats will always show this error when accessed.

steps.heading: Check for server issues
steps.body: If the problem is widespread, check OpenAI's status page to see if there's a temporary server-side issue affecting chat history.

faq.question: Can a deleted ChatGPT conversation be recovered?
faq.answer: No, once a conversation is deleted, it generally can't be restored, which is a common reason for this error.

faq.question: Is this error the same on the mobile app and website?
faq.answer: The underlying causes are similar, though the fix steps like clearing cache differ slightly between the app and browser.

faq.question: Will logging out delete my other saved chats?
faq.answer: No, logging out and back in doesn't delete your chat history — it only refreshes your session.

faq.question: How do I know if it's a server-wide issue?
faq.answer: Check OpenAI's status page for reported incidents; if others are experiencing the same error, it's likely temporary and server-side.
